info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Logistics Shipments Labels-v4-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Labels Retrieval API provides access to shipping labels associated with logistics shipments. Users can retrieve detailed label information, facilitating tracking and documentation for shipping processes. This API is particularly useful for logistics managers and application developers looking to integrate shipment tracking capabilities into their systems. By accessing shipment labels, users can enhance operational efficiency and improve customer service through better shipment visibility.

get.description: Fetch the label for a specific shipment, which includes essential tracking and shipping information. This endpoint allows users to access the label necessary for shipping documentation.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving shipment label information. This request should specifically include details pertaining to the shipment for which the label is being requested.

200.description: Request completed successfully, retrieving the shipment label.

ListLogisticsShipmentsLabelsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation of the shipments label endpoint.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation result.

audit.description: Information about the audit trail for the operation.

ListLogisticsShipmentsLabelsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the successful retrieval of shipment label operations.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Auditing information pertaining to the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request.
